propose.description:
Changing the Multi-Sig to a 3/4 multi-sig, removing quorum, setting passing threshold to 75%.

"If your DAO has *no quorum*, passing threshold is the percentage of the DAO's voting power that must vote 'yes' for a proposal to pass."
propose.title: Making the Multi-Sig a 3/4 multi-sig

propose.description: Replace old MB aejir wallet with the new one.

Swap half of NTRN to USDC
